title: Too pricey for what you get
text: Too pricey for what you get. Not worth the price.  Only buy if you don't live near a Dollar Tree or other discount store.  I bought a gelatin brain mold at Dollar Tree for a buck and it was way bigger than this gelatin heart.  But if you really need a heart-shaped mold, this will fit the purpose.  I just think the price is too steep for what you get.

product_metadata.title: Fun World Heart Jello Mold Halloween Decoration - Make Your Own Gelatin Hearts - Terrify Your Friends, Kids and Halloween Party Guests
features: Shock and terrify both your halloween friends and your normal friends with jello hearts.
This jello mold will freak kids out, too. Use delicious gelatin and make tasty heart treats.
For even more icky fun, use with our brain and hand gelatin molds.
description: Includes (1) heart gelatin mold. plastic. finished mold measures 8" wide x 6" high.
